title: An operator revokes leaked owner role sessions with a CDK-delivered deny
description:
Found by the second reader of docs/OWNER_CREDENTIAL_REVOCATION.md (chatticus-816a1a). Decision S6 (docs/OWNER_CREDENTIAL_RENEWAL.md 12.3, 17 R) says the aws:TokenIssueTime deny on ComputerSupervisorRole and ComputerOwnerScopedRole is a CDK change deployed by the normal path. No switch exists: wireComputerStarterOwnerRunTask (infra/lib/computer-host-start.ts) has no deny, deploy-chatticus-dedicated-account.sh passes no such context, so today the runbook offers an aws iam put-role-policy break-glass as a recorded exception to S6 and AGENTS.md. The second reader synthesized the exact change on development (two AWS::IAM::Policy resources named OwnerSessionsRevokedBefore, DateLessThan aws:TokenIssueTime) and did not deploy it. Build the switch: a CDK context ownerSessionsRevokedBefore (UTC time) read in wireComputerStarterOwnerRunTask, an OWNER_SESSIONS_REVOKED_BEFORE passthrough in infra/deploy-chatticus-dedicated-account.sh for the ControlPlane stack, CDK assertions (the two policies exist only when set; the roles keep an empty Policies property), and a live proof on development that the broker still issues a session after the time and the pre-existing owner recovers at its next renewal (this also settles runbook items U1 and U2). Then retire the break-glass path from the runbook.

Feature: Revoking leaked owner role sessions through CDK
  Scenario: A deny is synthesized for both owner roles
    Given the ControlPlane stack is synthesized with ownerSessionsRevokedBefore set to a UTC time
    When the template is read
    Then each of ComputerSupervisorRole and ComputerOwnerScopedRole has one Deny on all actions with DateLessThan aws:TokenIssueTime at that time
  Scenario: The broker still issues after the deny is deployed
    Given the deny is deployed on development with the time set to now
    When a member message starts the computer
    Then owner_broker_issued is logged after the time and no owner_broker_refused assume_role_failed is logged
